method: Manual browser interaction against local app; these cases are separate from component test counts.

cases.case: Scenario compares 8kg while preserving saved 10kg request, quote and chosen IE service
Explicit weight edits save the new value and invalidate outdated service selection
Unsaved document sender survives cached tracking lookup and page navigation
Unsaved document sender survives reload and switching to a different task and back
Invoice and packing quantity mismatch points to the actual item row; correction passes
Choose IE then check documents then view completed preparation checklist
Request to track a supplied number never substitutes the official example
Two-window stale save preserves local 12kg draft, displays newer saved 8kg, and prevents overwrite
Invoice inline preview renders actual item, contact, date and amount content
Checklist inline preview renders selected IE, current 10kg and pending verification items
Conversation composer and send button visible with no page overflow at 1280x800 and 390x844
Rates page has no page-level horizontal overflow at 390x844
Latest assistant response starts at its text instead of hiding it above source disclosures

limitations: Local rule mode exercised; live model experiment and real shipment lookup were not performed in this check.
